question: Who took the oath as the new Chief Minister of Haryana in the Assembly Election 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Nayab Singh Saini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shri Nayab Singh Saini** took the oath as the new Chief Minister of Haryana after the Assembly Election 2024.
 
• He succeeded **Shri Manohar Lal Khattar**, who served as the Chief Minister of Haryana from 2014 to 2024.
 
• Shri Nayab Singh Saini is known for his work in the Haryana Legislative Assembly and his efforts towards the development of the state.
 
• His election as the Chief Minister marks a significant change in the political landscape of Haryana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haryana Legislative Assembly**

 
 
• The Haryana Legislative Assembly, also known as the Haryana Vidhan Sabha, is the unicameral state legislature of Haryana.
 
• It consists of 90 members who are elected every five years.
 
• The assembly meets at Vidhan Bhavan in Chandigarh, the capital of Haryana.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister of Haryana**
 
 
• The Chief Minister of Haryana is the head of the government of the Indian state of Haryana.
 
• The Chief Minister is appointed by the Governor of Haryana.
 
• The term of the Chief Minister is for five years, subject to no term limits.
 
 
 
• **Political Landscape of Haryana**
 
 
• Haryana has a multi-party political system with major parties including the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Indian National Congress (INC), and the Jannayak Janata Party (JJP).
 
• The state has seen significant political shifts over the years, with various parties forming the government at different times.
 
 
 
• **Development Initiatives in Haryana**
 
 
• Haryana has been focusing on various development initiatives across sectors such as agriculture, education, and infrastructure.
 
• Recent governments have emphasized the importance of industrial development and improving the ease of doing business in the state.
